boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer casing exchanging heat with the environment

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner wall held at steam temperature via penalty Robin condition

objective.name: J
objective.description: Objective combining material cost and heat rejection through outer casing; minimization maximizes heat rejected

state_equation.description: Weak form of the linear heat conduction problem
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_D k \chi (\nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} \operatorname{pen} u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h u \delta u \,ds_x

adjoint_equation.description: Adjoint state equation for the objective
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_D k \chi (\nabla \delta u \cdot \nabla \tilde u) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} \operatorname{pen} \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x

boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer casing exchanging heat with the environment

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner wall held at steam temperature via penalty Robin condition

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: No Dirichlet boundaries are present; all physical boundaries are Robin.

fields.name: tilde_u
fields.rationale: Adjoint state variable appearing in the extracted adjoint equation; same regularity as state u.

constants.name: k
constants.description: solid thermal conductivity used in state equation (alias of k_0)
constants.rationale: State weak form uses symbol k; set equal to solid conductivity k_0.

constants.name: r_m
constants.rationale: Computed as (R + r_0)/2 for the initial level-set seed.

constants.name: r_h
constants.rationale: Chosen as approximately 15% of mid-radius to seed distinct holes without merging.

constants.name: N_holes
constants.description: number of evenly spaced holes in initial seed
constants.rationale: Selected for the extracted description of a ring of evenly spaced holes.

optimization_config.rationale: hmin/hmax chosen as approximately 1% and 10% of outer radius R=0.5; diffusion=1e-4 standard for level-set regularization; v0=1e-3; 40 iterations; level_set_initial formula implements the extracted description of a rotationally symmetric seed with a ring of 8 evenly spaced holes on the mid-radius circle; boundary_labels/fixed_labels preserved from extracted optimization_params.
